clauses.clause: sec. 1: establishes the Commission, up to 10 members selected by the Secretary of Agriculture, two co-chairs
sec. 2: Commission shall advise the President on the tobacco farming economy and recommend measures
sec. 3: Commission shall collect and review information, may recommend, hold hearings and form subcommittees
sec. 4: preliminary report by 2000-12-31; final report 6 months after first meeting
sec. 5: agencies to supply information; travel expenses; Agriculture to provide support; FACA functions delegated to the Secretary of Agriculture
sec. 6: Commission terminates 30 days after final report, not later than 2 years from the order, unless extended

moves.note: Held Federal Register printing 65 FR 58217-58218 read in full; six sections listed.
EO 13225 sec. 3(d) revokes EO 13168 by name; sec. 5 makes it effective 2001-09-30. Read in held FR printing 66 FR 50291-50292.
The revocation is of the whole order, not named sections, so every clause ended on 2001-09-30 at the latest.

No gap affects status or any clause state. Not settled: whether the commission terminated earlier under sec. 6 (about June 2001); that would only move first_end earlier. If the coordinator treats this as a blocking gap, the tier is T4.

propositions.claim: EO 13168 of 22 September 2000 is printed in the Federal Register at 65 FR 58217.

propositions.quote: There is established the ‘‘President’s Commission on Improving Economic Opportunity in Communities Dependent on Tobacco Production while Protecting Public Health’’

propositions.claim: Sec. 2 sets the Commission's advisory purpose.
propositions.quote: The Commission shall advise the President on changes occurring in the tobacco farming economy and recommend such measures as may be necessary
The Commission shall collect and review information about changes in the tobacco farming economy and Federal, State, and local initiatives

propositions.claim: Sec. 4 requires a preliminary and a final report.
propositions.quote: The Commission shall make a preliminary report to the President by December 31, 2000. A final report shall be submitted to the President 6 months after the Commission’s first meeting.

propositions.claim: Sec. 5 directs agency information, Agriculture support and delegates FACA functions.
propositions.quote: the Department of Agriculture shall provide the Commission with administrative services, funds, facilities, staff, and other support services

propositions.claim: Sec. 6 sets the Commission's own termination terms.
propositions.quote: The Commission shall terminate 30 days after submitting its final report, but not later than 2 years from the date of this order, unless extended by the President.

propositions.claim: EO 13225 sec. 3(d) revokes EO 13168 as a whole, by name.
propositions.quote: are revoked: ... (d) Executive Order 13168, establishing the President ’s Commission on Improving Economic Opportunity in Communities Dependent on Tobacco Production While Protecting Public Health

propositions.claim: EO 13225, signed 28 September 2001, took effect on 30 September 2001.
propositions.quote: This order shall be effective September 30, 2001.

propositions.claim: EO 13225 describes the revoked orders' committees as already terminated with work completed.
propositions.quote: The following Executive Orders, or sections thereof, which established committees that have terminated and whose work is completed, are revoked

review.conclusion_reason: Express named revocation effective September 30, 2001 supports operative NO at the cutoff and formal revoked status. The conclusion correctly states an upper bound on first_end. Clause end dates establish the revocation date, not necessarily the earliest cessation of each duty.
review.stop_code_verdict: confirmed: WEB fits the remaining earlier-termination refinement. The evidence slice supplies the held revocation but no final-report submission evidence. The cited archived report URL could not be retrieved during review, so its alleged May 14, 2001 date remains unverified; T5 is not supported.

verdicts.reason: Held Federal Register text identifies EO 13168, September 22, 2000, at 65 FR 58217.
Section 1 contains the quoted establishment language and confirms membership and co-chair provisions.
Section 2 contains the quoted advisory mandate.
Section 3 confirms information collection, recommendations, public-health consideration, hearings and subcommittees.
Section 4 confirms both reporting requirements and their stated deadlines.
The quotation confirms Agriculture support; the surrounding section 5(a)-(c) also confirms agency information duties and the qualified FACA delegation.
Section 6 contains the quoted termination terms, including the extension exception.
Held EO 13225 section 3 expressly says the listed orders are revoked; subsection (d) names EO 13168 without limiting the revocation to particular sections.
EO 13225 is dated September 28, 2001; section 5 expressly makes it effective September 30, 2001.
EO 13225 section 3 expressly describes the committees as having terminated and their work as completed.
